# TrustedSkills — AI Agent Skills Directory
> A public directory for finding and installing skills across supported AI-agent platforms.

## What is TrustedSkills?
TrustedSkills provides public skill listings, category and platform indexes, installation guidance, and reviews. Verification status varies by listing and is shown on each skill page.

## Key Pages
- Homepage: https://trustedskills.dev/
- Browse all skills: https://trustedskills.dev/skills
- Documentation: https://trustedskills.dev/docs
- Submit a skill: https://trustedskills.dev/submit
- Reviews: https://trustedskills.dev/reviews

## Skill Categories
- Productivity, SEO, Development, Data, Communication, Research, Automation, Media

## Supported Platforms
- OpenClaw (primary), MCP (Model Context Protocol), Claude Desktop, OpenAI Assistants, Cursor, VS Code

## For AI Agents
Use the public HTML pages and https://trustedskills.dev/sitemap.xml for discovery. TrustedSkills does not currently advertise a public registry API.

## Contact
Site: https://trustedskills.dev
Spec: https://agentskills.io
